current-review.title: Field health review completed
current-review.description: North Meadow is showing steady growth. Moisture and nutrients are supporting the current crop.

soil-sample.title: Topsoil laboratory results received
soil-sample.description: Composite samples were collected from five points at 0–30 cm depth. Results were added to the field’s soil record.

growth-check.title: Winter wheat growth inspection
growth-check.description: Crop establishment and canopy coverage were checked on the morning field walk. No significant pest pressure was recorded.

recent-rain.title: Light rain replenished the topsoil
recent-rain.description: An overnight shower brought moisture to the root zone. Field access resumed after the surface dried.

water-review.title: Water balance reviewed
water-review.description: Rainfall and root-zone moisture were reviewed. No supplemental watering was needed at this point.

spring-soil.title: Spring soil structure assessment
spring-soil.description: Root-zone samples were assessed for compaction, drainage, and biological activity. Crop residues remained evenly distributed.

nutrient-application.title: Spring nutrient application recorded
nutrient-application.description: A balanced fertilizer blend was applied. Application rates and machinery passes were logged for the growing season.

winter-review.title: Winter ground cover inspection
winter-review.description: Overwintering wheat was checked after a cold spell. Ground cover helped protect the soil from wind erosion.

autumn-test.title: Post-harvest soil test completed
autumn-test.description: Nutrient carryover and organic matter were measured to establish a baseline for the next growing season.

current-planting.title: Winter wheat planted for the 2026 season
current-planting.description: The field transitioned from soybeans to winter wheat. Seedbed preparation and sowing were completed across the field.

last-harvest.title: Soybeans harvest completed
last-harvest.description: Harvested grain was weighed and moisture tested. Residues were retained to protect the surface and return organic material to the soil.

cover-management.title: Field margins and drainage inspected
cover-management.description: Grass buffer strips were maintained. Drainage outlets and the field’s access track were checked after summer showers.

previous-soil.title: Annual soil fertility review
previous-soil.description: The season’s nutrient plan was reviewed against the previous harvest and crop rotation. Soil organic matter and pH were tracked against the baseline.

2024-harvest.title: Corn season closed
2024-harvest.description: The corn season was closed with harvest records and a soil condition assessment. A different crop was selected for the following year.

2024-structure.title: Reduced-tillage practice introduced
2024-structure.description: Cultivation depth was reduced to preserve soil structure. Crop residues were left on the surface to support soil biology and moisture retention.

2023-harvest.title: Winter wheat harvest archived
2023-harvest.description: Harvest and machinery records were added to the long-term land history for future crop planning.

baseline.title: Baseline land and soil survey
baseline.description: North Meadow was surveyed for soil texture, slope, and drainage. This assessment established the first reference point for long-term soil monitoring.
